topic: Quarantine list is capped at 5,000 sources per answer
detail: ListQuarantine names at most 5,000 sources (by URI) so one answer stays under gRPC's message size; totals count all. The proto has no paging, so 'orch quarantine list' shows the first 5,000 and 'assign' refuses a source beyond them. Options: (a) accept; (b) add paging (a proto change) if quarantine ever grows that large. Recommendation: (a).
